recognize_zh: TIA1染色中許多細胞的細胞質呈點狀、粗顆粒狀棕色陽性，陽性顆粒環繞於淡染的大核周圍，表示腫瘤細胞帶有細胞毒性顆粒相關蛋白，支持ALCL的細胞毒性T細胞表型。
features: Coarse dot-like granular cytoplasmic TIA1 staining in many cells
Granules surround pale, oval-to-irregular vesicular nuclei of intermediate-to-large cells
Widespread positivity with a granular background
describe_en: TIA1 immunostain shows coarse granular cytoplasmic staining in many intermediate-to-large cells with pale vesicular nuclei, with some interspersed negative cells. The dot-like granular pattern reflects cytotoxic granule-associated protein expression. Together with granzyme B and perforin positivity, this establishes a cytotoxic phenotype in ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive TIA1+ cells are small lymphocytes, whereas positivity here involves large atypical cells.
ENKTL is TIA1-positive but EBER-positive and CD56-positive, with angiodestruction rather than uniform CD30+ hallmark cells.
MEITL cells are monomorphic medium-sized CD8+/CD56+ cytotoxic cells in the intestine, not large pleomorphic CD30+ cells.
